rules.expected: validated three-state local-geometry trend is reported

binding.comparison: Require named observables for all three states and the qualitative trend: Li-O and tetrahedral Si-O shorter than the undoped Zn-O baseline, Al-F lengthening relative to Al-O, and local-angle changes; do not require one hidden numeric target. Compare complete same-definition shell distributions and stated summaries; method/site-dependent disagreement needs evidence, not forced agreement. Do not infer optical performance, exact dilute loading or an ionic compensation mechanism from this neutral fixed-cell model.
